messages:
Priya (People Ops): quick check — we have candidate on Thurs 11:30am PT. need confirmation on: Zoom link, consent to record, who's taking notes + who leads debrief. Also: request to livestream to Lina (hiring mgr) — ok?
Alex (Eng): i can cover system design and take notes if needed. prefer not to record video, audio-only ok?
Chen (Eng): i was planning to do frontend technical, can do notes backup. audio-only record ok with me.
Samir (Recruiter): candidate said audio recording is fine for internal debrief only. i added that consent to the calendar invite.
Priya (People Ops): thanks. @Lina do you want livestream (view-only) or just receive recording afterwards? livestream would use the policy room; need someone to start stream ~5m before.
Lina (Hiring Manager): prefer livestream view-only so I can drop in. no need to record livestream if recording is already captured. set to view-only please.
Priya (People Ops): noted. calendar-bot: scheduled stream slot requested — see snippet below.
calendar-bot: ``Streaming slot reserved: Redwood-AllHandsRoom (view-only), start 2026-05-14T11:25:00-07:00, end 2026-05-14T12:30:00-07:00``
Alex (Eng): small ask — i'm now doublebooked for 11:30–11:50. can Chen lead system design for first 20m and i'll join at 11:50 for live coding?
Chen (Eng): yep i can start. Alex jump in whenever.
Priya (People Ops): ok updated schedule in invite: Chen leads 11:30–11:50, Alex joins at 11:50. note-taking plan: Alex primary (when present) / Chen backup / Priya will collect debrief notes and create Eval doc.
Samir (Recruiter): i'll paste candidate's resume and 2 follow-up prompts into the interview kit. also flagging the rubric section we want to emphasize: execution, system design reasoning, collaboration.
Priya (People Ops): rubric snippet added to invite: 
``- Execution (0-4): clarity, tradeoffs, testability
- System Design (0-4): componentization, scaling concerns
- Collaboration (0-4): communication, receptiveness to hints
``
Alex (Eng): looks good. can we add a quick checklist for pre-call: headphones, screen sharing enabled, mic test? small things avoid friction.
Priya (People Ops): added pre-call checklist to interview kit and set reminder 30m prior.
Lina (Hiring Manager): one more thing — please remind panel to avoid whiteboard-heavy tasks in first 20m since candidate has limited setup.
Priya (People Ops): noted and added as instruction in the kit.
Chen (Eng): all set from my side. see you Thursday. :thumbsup:
Samir (Recruiter): i'll confirm candidate timezone again and re-send the invite with updated notes.
Priya (People Ops): thanks everyone — i'll follow up with final invite + stream link. :eyes:
